title: Microsoft Teams: live captions get a right-side panel and one settings menu
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout dates, automatic availability, caption policy controls and qualified Teams Premium requirement are supported. The licensing-review checklist item has no corresponding control row, a minor presentation issue.

claims.where: controls[0].scope; Why it matters; Scope; Governance controls
claims.claim: The Live captions meeting policy is per-user and controls whether users can turn captions on in meetings they attend.
claims.quote: This setting is a per-user policy and applies during a meeting. This setting controls whether the Turn on live captions option is available for the user to turn automatically generated live captions on or off in meetings that the user attends.

claims.claim: The Live captions policy defaults to Not enabled, but users can enable, represented by DisabledUserOverride.
claims.quote: Not enabled, but users can enable | DisabledUserOverride | This value is the default setting.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance controls
claims.claim: Setting the Live captions meeting policy to Off prevents assigned users from using live captions, including automatic start.
claims.quote: Off | Disabled | Users with this assigned policy can't use live captions in meetings or events.

claims.claim: Live translated captions require Live captions to be Not enabled, but users can enable, and setting it to Off turns translated captions off.
claims.quote: To turn on live translated captions, you must set Live captions to Not enabled, but users can enable in the corresponding meeting policy in the Teams admin center. To turn off live translated captions, set Live captions to Off.

claims.claim: The Teams settings and policies reference instead labels the Live captions default Off, but organizers and co-organizers can turn them on.
claims.quote: Live captions | Off, but organizers and co-organizers can turn them on | This setting is a per-user policy and applies during a meeting.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The Live captions control is at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Live captions.
claims.quote:
go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
2. Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one.
3. From the drop-down for Live captions, select Not enabled, but users can enable(default value) or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -LiveCaptionsEnabledType Disabled turns off live captions for users assigned that policy.
claims.quote:
To turn off live captions for users with this policy, run the following script:
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -LiveCaptionsEnabledType Disabled

claims.claim: No separate tenant UI or automation switch for the right-side panel or automatic-start toggle is documented as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams live captions right side panel automatic start tenant administrator disable Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy automatic captions. Opened meeting-transcription-captions and settings-policies-reference; searched Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy text for captions and automatic. No separate switch found.

claims.claim: Teams admin release notes say the live captions profanity filter default changed from On to Off.
claims.quote: We are updating the default profanity filter setting for live captions from On to Off across Teams meetings, calls, events, and Microsoft Teams Rooms (MTR) devices

claims.claim: That profanity-default change affects users who have never configured their live captions profanity-filter preference.
claims.quote: This change will only affect users who have never configured their live captions profanity filter preference. Users who have already set their preference will keep their current setting.

claims.claim: The admin profanity-filtering meeting policy described in the release notes controls live and saved meeting transcripts, not the captions-menu preference.
claims.quote: Teams admins can use a meeting policy to control whether profane words are masked in live transcription and saved meeting transcripts. Filtering is on by default.

claims.claim: Live captions continue to follow each participant's own profanity setting.
claims.quote: Live captions continue to follow each participant’s profanity setting.

claims.quote: This update introduces a new right-side panel layout for live captions and consolidates caption settings into a single menu.

claims.claim: The checklist asks administrators to review Teams Premium licence holders, but the controls table has no licensing-review row.
claims.quote: Review who holds Teams Premium licences if your organisers rely on live translated captions outside the large-audience-event exception. Table rows: Whether users can turn on live captions in meetings; Tenant switch for the right-side captions panel or the automatic-start toggle.
claims.fix: Remove the Before rollout checklist bullet beginning 'Review who holds Teams Premium licences'; retain the already supported licence requirement and event exception in Cost and licensing.
